item_name: Rothco Canvas Tanker Style Tool Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Canvas Tanker Style Tool Bag offers versatile storage for tools, survival gear, gym clothes, and more. Constructed from unwashed heavyweight cotton canvas, it can support heavy loads. With its 19 inches X 9 inches X 6 inches main zipper compartment, durable cross-hatched stitched dual carry handles, and canvas loops for shoulder strap attachment, it provides ample space and carrying options. Perfect for mechanics, plumbers, electricians, athletes, and anyone in need of a heavy-duty multipurpose bag.
